question: What is the Resulticks acquisition supposed to unlock — revenue synergies or cost savings?

beats.line: The Resulticks acquisition is positioned as a revenue synergy play, not cost savings.
beats.headline: REVENUE SYNERGY
beats.action: Stacked paper sheets drop onto a cream chip and settle square in frame.
beats.delivery: [presenting to camera] The Resulticks acquisition is positioned as a revenue synergy play, not cost savings.

beats.line: The one point five billion dollar deal adds AI-driven customer data capabilities to the compliance platform.
beats.headline: $1.5B
beats.action: The previous chip slides off the top edge as the top sheet peels away into a paper coin stack; an orange paper ribbon runs from the stacked sheets on the left to the coin stack on the right, and a coin-sized cream tag reading '$1.5B' sits beside the ribbon with a short black line pointing at it.
beats.delivery: [excited] The one point five billion dollar deal adds AI-driven customer data capabilities to the compliance platform.

beats.line: That turns a point solution into an integrated, end-to-end platform.
beats.headline: END-TO-END
beats.action: The previous chip flips away as the coin stack flattens back into the stacked sheets, which press together into one slab; the orange ribbon is already in place, and a stencilled arrow lands across the slab end to end.
beats.delivery: That turns a point solution into an integrated, end-to-end platform.

beats.line: Diginex can now serve enterprise customers across two distinct workflows.
beats.headline: 2 WORKFLOWS
beats.action: The previous chip is covered as the stacked sheets unfold flat into a grid-paper board; two paper folders slide onto it and hold, an orange paper arrow running from the board to the folders.
beats.delivery: Diginex can now serve enterprise customers across two distinct workflows.

beats.line: One is sustainability and compliance. The other is customer intelligence and marketing.
beats.headline: ESG + MARKETING
beats.action: The previous chip slides off the left edge as the two paper folders open one after the other on the grid-paper board, the orange arrow already in place between them.
beats.delivery: One is sustainability and compliance. The other is customer intelligence and marketing.

beats.line: Enterprises buying compliance can also buy marketing automation from the same vendor. That increases wallet share.
beats.headline: WALLET SHARE
beats.action: The previous chip flips away as the two paper folders slide together on the grid-paper board; a paper hand enters and presses them into one bundle, the orange arrow still running to them.
beats.delivery: Enterprises buying compliance can also buy marketing automation from the same vendor. That increases wallet share.

beats.line: The risk is integration complexity. Diginex has absorbed four distinct acquisitions across multiple geographies.
beats.headline: 4 ACQUISITIONS
beats.action: The previous chip slides off the bottom edge as the grid-paper board tears into four stamped documents that stack unevenly and stop; a black paper string runs from them to a small paper bar chart.
beats.delivery: [fast-paced] The risk is integration complexity. Diginex has absorbed four distinct acquisitions across multiple geographies.

beats.line: General and administrative costs rose three point four million dollars, to eight point one million.
beats.headline: $8.1M G&A
beats.action: The previous chip is covered as one stamped document rises into a taller bar on the paper bar chart; the black string is already in place, and a coin-sized cream tag reading '$2.2M' sits beside it with a short black line pointing at it.
beats.delivery: General and administrative costs rose three point four million dollars, to eight point one million.

beats.line: What matters next is cross-sell traction, and revenue growth outpacing the cost of integration.
beats.headline: CROSS-SELL TRACTION
beats.action: The previous chip flips down as the paper bar chart collapses back into the stacked sheets on violet ground; a paper hand taps the top sheet, a cream ribbon running from the sheets to the hand.
beats.delivery: What matters next is cross-sell traction, and revenue growth outpacing the cost of integration.

beats.line: Without that, it becomes financial engineering rather than a strategic unlock.
beats.headline: STRATEGIC UNLOCK?
beats.action: The previous chip slides off as the paper hand lifts away and a torn strip settles across the stacked sheets, the cream ribbon still in place; the slab holds with the strip laid over it.
beats.delivery: Without that, it becomes financial engineering rather than a strategic unlock.
